label: Звание
description: A 10-sentence usage card for звание (rank; title).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Звание' is the neuter nominative subject. 'Новое' and 'высокое' agree in the neuter nominative, and 'очень' intensifies. A clean evaluative statement.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Звание' is the neuter accusative direct object of 'получил'; for neuter nouns the accusative equals the nominative. 'Высокое' agrees in the neuter accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Звания' is the neuter genitive after the negative 'нет'. 'Воинского' agrees in the neuter genitive. A natural way to state a lack of rank.
Strategic focus: Dative with preposition. 'Званию' is the neuter dative after 'благодаря', expressing cause. 'Получил уважение' reports the result. A useful cause-and-effect pattern.
Strategic focus: Instrumental object. 'Званием' is the neuter instrumental required by 'гордится'. 'Своим' agrees in the neuter instrumental. The standard 'proud of' construction.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Звании' is the neuter prepositional after 'в', marking the context. 'Есть привилегии' states what comes with it. A clear topical pattern.

Strategic focus: Accusative object with dative recipient. 'Звание' is the neuter accusative object of 'присвоили', and 'ему' is the dative recipient. 'Капитана' is a genitive specifying the rank. A formal ceremony pattern.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Звания' is the neuter nominative plural subject of 'дают'. 'Эти' agrees in the plural, and 'много прав' states the effect. A simple plural statement.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Званий' is the neuter genitive plural after the quantifier 'много'; note the soft-stem ending in -ий. 'Разных' agrees, and 'в армии' sets the place.

Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. 'Званиях' is the neuter prepositional plural after 'о', marking the topic. 'Новых' agrees in the plural, and 'объявили' is the impersonal verb. A formal announcement line.
